source.title: 3D-Mesh NRW (Geobasis NRW)
source.format: I3S (Indexed 3D Scene Layer), service version 1.7, meshpyramids/node-switching LOD

roi.describes: Halle 9, Halle 10, Boulevard, Piazza / Eingang Sued approach

localArtifact.format: GLB (glTF 2.0 binary), one mesh+material+JPEG texture per source node

knownLimitation: The ROI-overlap test on the I3S node tree is deliberately conservative (bounding-sphere, not exact OBB) to avoid false negatives after an axis-aligned test silently dropped whole branches with rotated OBBs. That conservatism, combined with the mesh-pyramid tree not always subdividing a parent footprint contiguously among its children, means the extracted set is not one seamless surface -- it is real photogrammetric geometry+texture from the official service, but with gaps between the picked nodes rather than full contiguous coverage. Tightening the ROI test to exact OBB-vs-AABB intersection would close most of those gaps; not done in this pass.
